about: Game texts of this language (converted from stringtable_en.xml). A mod can override single keys.

strings.Infantry Intro:
The easiest force to build and main force in the 
battlefield.
strings.Armour Intro:
Armour has matchless mobility and is good against 
infantry with its large-caliber machine gun.
strings.Artillery Intro:
It makes a lot of forces incapable of fighting back, 
yet features slow movement.
strings.Rocket Intro:
Rocket launcher can carry out long-range strikes 
with its powerful rocket. However, it moves slowly 
and goes without armor protection.
strings.Tank Intro:
Featuring good armour and firepower, tank can get 
across the entrenchment easily and destroy enemies 
without losing any movement.
strings.Heavy Tank Intro:
Known for formidable long-range firepower, heavy 
tank can definitely strike back artillery. It is also able 
to across the entrenchment and destroy all enemies 
without losing any movement.
strings.Destroyer Intro:
This primary warship is mainly used for marine 
escort and patrol.
strings.Cruiser Intro:
The main warship in naval battles has good armor 
and kick-ass fire power.
strings.BattleShip Intro:
Equipped with large-caliber machine gun and heavy 
armor, it's self-evident that battleship has good attack 
and defense capability.
strings.Aircraft Carrier Intro:
Aircraft carrier is crucial to marine war. Use the 
seaborne aircraft to bomb your target, but don't 
expect too much from its self-defense.
strings.Airstrike Intro:
Use fighter plane equipped with large-caliber machine
 gun to launch air strike in hostile territory.
strings.Bomber Intro:
Bombing in hostile territory would blow all troops, 
cities and industrial facilities there.
[Use once over 1 rounds.]
strings.Airborne Force Intro:
An airborne infantry appears in specified land area.
[Use once over 2 rounds.]
strings.Nuclear Bomb Intro:
Release nuclear bomb on some area to wipe out 
troops and infrastructure there.
[Use once over 3 rounds.]
strings.City Intro:
Upgrading a city to higher level leads to more 
production and force supplies. High-level city allows 
you to build infantry.
strings.Industry Intro:
Upgrading industry to higher level leads to more 
industry output and force supplies. High-level industrial 
zone allows you to build superior mechanized forces.
strings.Airport Intro:
When launching air strike, airport is surely an 
essential installation which can provide more supplies 
for forces.
strings.Land Fort Intro:
Enhancing defensive power of the force could make 
it fight back artilleries and double counterattack 
against warships.
strings.Entrenchment Intro:
Raising defensive power of our forces can also 
lower the hostile movement.
strings.Antiaircraft Intro:
Use air defense weapons to alleviate damage from 
air attack and bombing in a large part.
strings.Radar Intro:
Under radar scout, the damage of long-range fires 
and airstrikes could be lowered effectively.
strings.Research Intro:
It takes 3 rounds to complete upgrade technology and 
upon completion cards of this level would be unlocked.
[Use once over 3 rounds.]
strings.Carrier Intro:
The army could move around the sea if putting 
equipment in the transport ship.
strings.Assault Art Intro: Assault art helps our forces get more attack power.
strings.Defend Art Intro: Defense art help our forces have stronger defense.
strings.Commander Intro:
You can also improve your force by using commander, 
whose capability is determined by the rank.
strings.Supply Line Intro:
Replenish the damaged forces in a single area.
[Use once over 3 rounds.]
strings.Ace Forces Intro:
Name one force to go up a level as bonus.
[Use once over 1 rounds.]
strings.axis battle intro 1:
By order of the fuehrer, you will take elite troops to 
attack Poland and General Guderian is going to fight 
with you. Commander! The high command is looking 
forward to your success!
strings.axis battle intro 2:
The high command has made a plan to march westward, 
which splits into two lines. After bypassing the Maginot 
Line, army group A will invade Netherlands and Belgium, 
finally Paris. Army group B aims to attack Denmark and 
Norway in North Europe for needed resources. General 
Guderian would join you to lead the campaign.
strings.axis battle intro 3:
It's so exciting to see our forces pass through the Arch 
of Triumph and the fuehrer is very pleased. However, 
the intelligence tells us British and French troops are 
attempting to fight back. Of course, we won't let it 
happen! Marshal Goering will support you with his ace 
air forces.
strings.axis battle intro 4:
Germany was so unstoppable in last military actions that 
the chancellor desires to expand to the Balkans. 
Considering Greece gets support from Britain, we invite 
Bulgaria and Romania to join our glorious expansion. 
General Graziani also agrees to assist you on the sea!
strings.axis battle intro 5:
Knowing the Italian troops are swamped in North Africa, 
the fuehrer concerns our supply line in Mediterranean 
would be cut off if Britain seizes North Africa. Therefore, 
we must send relief troops immediately. Commander! 
General Rommel is back from vacation. He will lead the 
best tank army to head North Africa with you.
strings.axis battle intro 6:
It's time to approach the Soviet Union! The Russians 
keep losing because of poor preparation. Now General 
Guderian starts to siege Soviet troops stationed in Kiev 
and the fuehrer hopes you could meet in Moscow as 
soon as possible.Commander! This would be the greatest 
victory ever if you can make it!
strings.axis battle intro 7:
Now America has cut off our energy sources and 
deployed a huge navy in Pearl Harbor, which stimulates 
the high command to set defeating Americans as our 
urgent task. General Yamamoto has prepared the 
operational plan and the Mikado places high hopes on 
us.
strings.axis battle intro 8:
South Pacific nations, home to rich resources which we 
are dying for, have attracted a lot of attention recently. 
To prevent our movement, America and Britain have done 
a lot of things while Australia starts to get prepared 
across the country. Commander! It's more than boldness 
you need to conquer them.
strings.axis battle intro 9:
Although we won a lot of battles in Asia, our original 
goal has not yet come true. Currently, China joins 
Britain to fight us in Burma. Commander! If we mess 
up this time, all previous efforts are in vain.
strings.axis battle intro 10:
It's unbelievable that, according to the intelligence, 
America is building some devastating weapon. The fuehrer 
makes a prompt decision to bring forward the plan of 
North America expedition. He also discusses details with 
Italy and Japan. Commander! This is our only chance. 
Don't screw up!
strings.allies battle intro 1:
The country is falling into the most dangerous situation. 
At this time, General Zhukov is fighting against Guderian's 
army in Kiev while General Rokossovsky against Finland 
and Rommel's coalition forces in the north. Commander! 
You are our last hope to protect Moscow!
strings.allies battle intro 2:
Commander! Japanese joint fleet is launching strikes on 
our naval base in Midway Island. If they succeed, all 
the west coast would be under threat. We cannot afford 
that. Moreover, we cannot let the president down. Go 
and roll them back! General Nimitz will assist you.
strings.allies battle intro 3:
Rommel with his armour army becomes our strongest 
enemy in North Africa. General Montgomery is seeking 
opportunity to beat them. Commander! Maybe the war 
will end up earlier if you join in.
strings.allies battle intro 4:
Commander! The supreme headquarters resolve on a 
large-scale counterattack to kick invaders out of our 
territory. During this operation, General Zhukov, General 
Rokossovsky and you with your own army should launch 
a general offensive from 3 different directions.
strings.allies battle intro 5:
As the battle in North Africa comes to an end, the 
supreme headquarters plan to defeat Italy, the weakest 
among axis nations, and compel them to quit the war. 
Commander! Unfortunately Italy is not the only enemy 
we face. Those German troops in Greece are what we 
should really worry about!
strings.allies battle intro 6:
Intelligence shows Japan keeps rallying forces in Burma. 
It seems they're ready to invade India which is the last 
British base in Asia. We have to get everything prepared. 
Good news is our ally Chinese forces will give us a 
hand.
strings.allies battle intro 7:
To support Soviet Union in eastern front and encircle 
Germany, the supreme headquarters decide to land 
Europe. We have been preparing this for a long time. 
Commander! This campaign could be the largest and 
toughest you ever do.
strings.allies battle intro 8:
Germany is just ahead of us! I believe things will be 
much more brutal when we get in there. Every step 
forward requires us to pay a big price. The heavy 
casualties that Soviet Union suffered in eastern front 
are a good example. Commander! Once you conquer 
Germany, we will get a big win over European theater.
strings.allies battle intro 9:
We are the most important force for allies in Far East. 
For a long time we keep fighting against invaders and 
never get conquered. Commander! It's time to take back 
the territory we lost! Soviet Red Army will assist us in 
the north east.
strings.allies battle intro 10:
Looking back in history you'll find no one, including 
Genghis Khan, has ever set foot on Japanese mainland 
for a fight. But now a good opportunity comes to us. 
We cannot miss it. Commander! You must figure out 
how to eliminate their strong navy first.
strings.wto battle intro 1:
Seeing the emergence of socialist camp in Far East, 
American-led NATO is totally provoked. They actually try 
to meddle in our reunification. We have to think about 
how to resist them. Commander! This is never easy, 
because we're really left behind by their armament.
strings.wto battle intro 2:
The headquarters just receive the information that a 
great number of well-equipped Indian troops show up on 
the western border. They even cross the boundary. 
Commander! It's an emergency. You must leave for the 
front line right now!
strings.wto battle intro 3:
We must get a head start when both America and 
Britain have their eyes on oil resources in Middle East. 
Commander! If we lose our place here, we would have 
nothing to compete with them.
strings.wto battle intro 4:
To ease the pressure in other battleground, America and 
Canada form a joint fleet and start an attack in the 
Pacific. You may want to know Marshal Nimitz takes the 
lead. Commander! Fighting in the sea is the last thing 
we want! Our navy forces are way too weak.
strings.wto battle intro 5:
After getting military aid from America, Turkey launches 
assault on our ally Bulgaria. Commander! We need you 
to help Bulgaria destroy Turkey as well as Greece and 
Yugoslavia. You must be quick! End up the war before 
the arrival of America's reinforcement. Or we will be 
thrown into a passive position.
strings.wto battle intro 6:
Within weeks, NATO allies led by America and Britain 
have seized Germany. They even cross the Germany-
Poland border. At the same time, French and Italian 
armies are advancing to Hungary. Commander! The 
headquarters command you to gather troops immediately 
and set out for the front line. Remember to start 
counterattack when things are under control.
strings.wto battle intro 7:
After multiple successes against WTO, our sphere of 
influence has extended all over Europe, Asia and Africa. 
But we will never stop! The headquarters are planning 
to assault South America and build a missile launch 
site there, which could force America to make peace 
negotiations. Commander! America can be very tricky to 
deal with.
strings.nato battle intro 1:
As the Soviets carry guided missile launcher to Cuba, 
sthey could fire nuclear missile any minute. Commander! 
The president orders you to destroy those devastating 
weapons by any means necessary. Also kick Soviets 
out of South America.
strings.nato battle intro 2:
It's not a secret that Soviet Union is scheming to 
approach West Europe, with Poland, Bulgaria, Romania 
and Hungary all its military allies. At present, they have 
fully controlled Germany after getting across Berlin Wall. 
Those who can compete with them in Europe are only 
Britain, France and Italy. Commander! This is the last 
line of defense. The future of Europe is in your hands.
strings.nato battle intro 3:
Now the Soviet Union and its allies have taken Africa. 
We must send reinforcement as soon as possible, or 
the enemy will soon target Mediterranean regions and 
then Europe. Commander! General de Gaulle is going 
to join us in the war.
strings.nato battle intro 4:
The headquarters desire to liberate Middle East for next 
step. As part of the plan, we would confuse the Soviets 
by breaking through Turkey while the truth is you 
directly go to the Middle East from where you are in 
Africa. It's a long-prepared plan. Now it's time to turn 
into action!
strings.nato battle intro 5:
It's a good idea to get into Asia by way of India. When 
we're moving, however, India just turns its back on us. 
Meanwhile we find Soviet army shows up in India. 
Commander! The Soviets come to this through diplomacy, 
but our only resort is fighting!
strings.nato battle intro 6:
It's good news that a rift occurs between the Soviet 
Union and China. A border war even breaks out. 
Commander! Will you take this chance to cut off Soviet 
Union's supply line in South Pacific? Australia is our 
only ally there.
strings.nato battle intro 7:
Defeating the Soviet Union in its true sense means to 
make them surrender at home. I know you can do this. 
As the army is in position, headquarters command a 
general offensive. Commander! Make progress very 
carefully. The Soviets are well known for their strong 
mind!

strings.war medal 1 level 1 intro: It would be level 1 with assault and defense art.
strings.war medal 1 level 2 intro: It would be level 2 with assault and defense art.
strings.war medal 1 level 3 intro:
When you first build infantry, it would be level 2 with 
assault and defense art.
strings.war medal 2 level 1 intro: Give your air forces more combat power.
strings.war medal 2 level 2 intro:
Give your air forces more combat power and operation 
scope.
strings.war medal 2 level 3 intro:
Give your air forces more combat power and operation 
scope. What’s more, there’s no limit on how many 
times you dispatch them.
strings.war medal 3 level 1 intro: When you first build artillery, it would upgrade to level 1.
strings.war medal 3 level 2 intro:
When you build artillery and rocket launcher forces 
for the first time, they would rise to level 1 .
strings.war medal 3 level 3 intro:
When you build artillery and rocket launcher forces 
for the first time, they would rise to level 1 with 
defense tactics.
strings.war medal 4 level 1 intro:
The armour forces are increased to level 1 at the 
very beginning of establishment.
strings.war medal 4 level 2 intro:
Both armour and tank forces are increased to level 1 
at the very beginning of establishment.
strings.war medal 4 level 3 intro:
When you start building armour, tank and heavy tank 
forces, they are upgraded to level 1.
strings.war medal 5 level 1 intro: All land forces you build are with carriers.
strings.war medal 5 level 2 intro:
All land forces you build are with carriers. Building 
destroyer and cruiser forces gets you directly to 
level 1.
strings.war medal 5 level 3 intro:
All land forces you build are with carriers. Building 
destroyer, cruiser, battleship and aircraft carrier 
forces gets you directly to level 1.
strings.war medal 6 level 1 intro:
Each round gives you 10% extra production and 
industry values.
strings.war medal 6 level 2 intro:
Each round gives you 20% extra production and 
industry values.
strings.war medal 6 level 3 intro:
Each round gives you 30% extra production and 
industry values.

strings.bank tip: In each campaign you only have one chance to get a loan.
strings.tip 1:
With movement left, you can supply your forces one time after each round. You 
can also supply strength supplies for injured forces in cities, industrial zone, 
airports and ports.
strings.tip 2:
After destroying enemies, your soldiers may have the chance to get more morale. 
If surrounded by enemies, they may have mess morale.
strings.tip 3:
Armours, artilleries, rocket Launchers,tanks and heavy tanks all need to be recruited 
in industrial zones while the navies in port. If you want to activate air forces, build 
an airport first.
strings.tip 4:
Armour army scares infantry most. Land fort is your first choice to defend navy 
attack.
strings.tip 5:
Entrenchment are cheap but good defensive work, however, they cannot stand up 
to tanks.
strings.tip 6:
For a large volume of enemies within an area, try to use air bombing. But it would 
be less effective if there are antiaircraft.
strings.tip 7:
Armours are the quickest military forces and your top choice to seize areas without 
defense.
strings.tip 8: Artilleries make enemies unable to fight back unless they have land forts.
strings.tip 9:
Carriers are the only option to get your army at sea. All carriers at sea have the 
same speed.
strings.tip 10:
High-level cards need support from high-level technology. If you find some advanced 
cards unavailable, it's time to upgrade your technology with research card.
strings.tip 11:
Soldiers from different countries have different combat capability. America and 
Germany are strong in navy, army and air force. They also have commanders of 
high level.
strings.tutorails 1: Hello, Commander! Let me show you how to do this.
strings.tutorails 2:
First of all, production and industry values are necessary 
pillar for battle. Here is what we got.
strings.tutorails 3:
Basically, they come from output of our cities and industrial 
zones. Touch each area you will find these two values in 
there.
strings.tutorails 4:
By touching the area where our forces locate you can move 
them. Blue arrows point to movable areas while red arrows 
point to battlegrounds.
strings.tutorails 5:
If you find any forces with the same base color as ours, 
they are our allies. Please don't attack them.
strings.tutorails 6:
All forces have movement. When it comes down to 0, the 
force  can't move.
strings.tutorails 7:
Each area allows four armies at most. We can adjust how 
they distribute.
strings.tutorails 8:
Battleships can navigate at sea. Armies can also enter the 
sea as long as equipped with carriers.
strings.tutorails 9:
The left bottom button is tactical card, through which you 
can carry out tactical operation.
strings.tutorails 10:
They are classified into forces, development, and strategy. 
Each has unique function. Using any of these cards would 
cost you production and industry values.
strings.tutorails 11:
Only the city or industrial zone of high level could recruit 
army while port is the only place to recruit navy.
strings.tutorails 12:
If your technology level is lower than request, you are 
unable to use the card until you upgrade the technology.
strings.tutorails 13:
Some special cards need time to cool down before you use 
them again.
strings.tutorails 14: Command card is only applicable for one military unit.
strings.tutorails 15:
Build airports to launch air strikes or bomb hostile territories, 
but air forces have limited combat areas.
strings.tutorails 16:
Through the System button on top right corner, you can 
save the game, look up options, restart or quit.
strings.tutorails 17:
After all deployment, you can touch the wait button in right 
bottom corner to wait for next round.
strings.tutorails 18:
Commander! You would fail if all of your land territory are 
lost. Please take note of it.
strings.commander complain 1: Commander! This is not good for our friendship.
strings.commander complain 2: Sometimes I doubt you are a friend or enemy!
strings.commander retreat 2:
Maybe I'm too rushed to advance. My army needs 
adjustment.
strings.commander retreat 3: I fight to the last minute, but still cannot repel enemies.
strings.commander retreat 4:
I underestimated the enemy's willpower. I need to rework 
tactics.
strings.commander retreat 5:
We must preserve our strength before beating back enemies. 
Retreat!
strings.commander return 1: Let's shake enemies with our gunfire!
strings.commander return 2: Full speed ahead! Let's give enemies a surprise attack.
strings.commander return 3: Fight to the last minute until the last man!
strings.commander return 4: Soldiers! Let's show enemies what we are capable of!
strings.commander return 5:
Talking about attack and defense, no one is better than my 
troops.
strings.commander failure 1:
Commander! No matter how incredible you were, this time 
you throw our country into a totally passive position. The 
headquarters cannot accept your explanation. You will be 
discharged all commanding powers you have.
strings.commander failure 2:
Commander! You failed to accomplish the goal on time, 
that's why we lost the war. The headquarters just send a 
notice that all commanding powers you have are discharged.
strings.commander victory 1:
The headquarters could never imagine that you win in such 
a short time. That's a perfect victory! You will be rewarded 
with 50 extra medals.
strings.commander victory 2:
You have shown outstanding military talents in this battle. 
It's almost a perfect victory! You will be rewarded with 25 
extra medals.
strings.commander victory 3:
It's obvious that you have much more predominance in the 
battle. The enemy is never a problem. You will have 15 
extra medals.
strings.commander victory 4:
Commander! The dogged enemies are so offensive that you 
almost lose your confidence, but you finally win.  You will 
be rewarded with 5 extra medals.
strings.commander victory 5:
Commander! You didn't win until the last moment, so it 
makes sense that the headquarters won't give you anything 
for reward.
strings.commander victory 1 no award:
The headquarters could never imagine that you win in such 
a short time. That's a perfect victory!
strings.commander victory 2 no award:
You have shown outstanding military talents in this battle. 
It's almost a perfect victory!
strings.commander victory 3 no award:
It's obvious that you have much more predominance in the 
battle. The enemy is never a problem.
strings.commander victory 4 no award:
Commander! The dogged enemies are so offensive that you 
almost lose your confidence, but you finally win.
strings.axis battle 1 Guderian 1:
In order to make sudden strike, my armour forces will move 
to Warsaw without resting.
strings.axis battle 1 Guderian 2:
If you want to attack Warsaw with me, you must take 
other cities and regions first and quickly.
strings.axis battle 1 Guderian 3:
Commander! Try to win the war as soon as possible. The 
fuehrer doesn't give us too much time.
strings.axis battle 1 Guderian 4:
My armour forces have broken through the outer defense 
line. Now Warsaw is so close to us.
strings.axis battle 1 Guderian 5: If we fight together, the victory can come earlier!
strings.axis battle 2 Guderian 1:
Commander! This time you lead army group B to attack 
Denmark and Norway in North Europe.
strings.axis battle 2 Guderian 2:
It's not the first time we work together. You must know my 
tactics well.
strings.axis battle 2 Guderian 3:
I'm coming near to Paris very soon. Hope to see your army 
right then.
strings.axis battle 2 Guderian 4:
My armour forces are going forward at amazing speed. We 
even have no time to take prisoners.
strings.axis battle 2 de Gaulle 1:
It's a life or death moment. Soldiers! Use your weapons to 
kill enemies before they kill you.
strings.axis battle 3 Rommel 1:
Commander! My armour forces are mopping up French 
forces in the south.
strings.axis battle 3 Rommel 2:
Take care of the British army across the British Channel. 
Marshal Goering will support you with air forces.
strings.axis battle 3 Goering 1:
My air forces are in position. I don't think the British have 
much air superiority now.
strings.axis battle 4 Graziani 1:
Commander! My battleships will stand by you. It's a piece 
of cake to win the battle.
strings.axis battle 4 Graziani 2:
I didn't realize their costal artillery is so accurate. My 
battleships suffer heavy damage.
strings.axis battle 4 Guider 1:
Commander! You must completely destroy the hostile fleets 
for final success of the campaign.
strings.axis battle 5 Rommel 1:
Italian army is not as good as we thought. So the fuehrer 
sends us to help them in North Africa.
strings.axis battle 5 Rommel 2:
The enemies are a few times more than us, but not 
combat power! We only need to focus on Britain and 
France.
strings.axis battle 5 Rommel 3:
German armour forces are powerful. When they come to us, 
holding our ground is winning!
strings.axis battle 5 Montgomery 1: There's no way to stop my tiger tank.
strings.axis battle 6 Guderian 1: Commander! My army is heading for Kiev.
strings.axis battle 6 Guderian 2:
Your task is to occupy Minsk, and then we meet in 
Moscow.
strings.axis battle 6 Guderian 3:
Finland and Hungary will help us, but don't count too much 
on them.
strings.axis battle 6 Rokossovsky 1: Soldiers! Stand your ground! Defend your country!
strings.axis battle 6 Zhukov 1: The fighting is pointless if our capital falls.
strings.axis battle 7 Yamamoto 1: Commander! Assaulting American fleet can be very risky.
strings.axis battle 7 Yamamoto 2:
Once drawn the katana cannot be sheathed until it kills. 
Fight with all your might.
strings.axis battle 7 Nimitz 1:
Soldiers! Get back to your position. We're attacked! It's not 
exercise.
strings.axis battle 8 Guider 1:
Commander! You must seize these areas quickly, because 
the emperor needs resources.
strings.axis battle 8 Guider 2:
The thing is Britain has sent a strong fleet ahead to block 
our progress.
strings.axis battle 8 Guider 3: I suggest using air forces to hit their fleet.
strings.axis battle 9 Yamamoto 1:
Commander! China and Britain are massing forces in Burma. 
They are going to fire back.
strings.axis battle 9 Yamamoto 2:
We suffered heavy loss in the Pacific war. We cannot help 
you anymore.
strings.axis battle 10 Goering 1:
Actually American has got the hang of nuclear technology. 
That's why the fuehrer hurries to start the war before we 
are ready.
strings.axis battle 10 Goering 2:
We convince Italy and Japan to fight North America with us, 
so we can relieve some stress.
strings.axis battle 10 Goering 3:
Commander! The fuehrer and all fellowmen are hoping to 
see you back in triumph.
strings.axis battle 10 Patton 1: Soldiers! Use our tank to crush enemies down!
strings.axis battle 10 MacArthur 1: Be brave! Man! Only the daredevil can survive.
strings.allies battle 1 Zhukov 1:
Commander! Our country is facing the most dangerous 
moment!
strings.allies battle 1 Zhukov 2:
We take charge of different places, but it's obvious your 
defense is the most important.
strings.allies battle 1 Zhukov 3:
Soviet Union is very large, but we can find no way out 
except Moscow in the back.
strings.allies battle 1 Rokossovsky 1:
I have executed some deserters myself. Don't doubt my 
loyalty.
strings.allies battle 2 Nimitz 1:
After air strikes on Tokyo, Japan is targeting the Midway 
Island for revenge.
strings.allies battle 2 Nimitz 2:
Midway Island is an important naval harbor in Pacific Ocean. 
Considering its strategic value, we have to hold it by any 
means.
strings.allies battle 2 Nimitz 3: Commander! My fleet will support you with all strength.
strings.allies battle 2 Yamamoto 1: This time almost all navy in the emperor turn out.
strings.allies battle 2 Yamamoto 2: This sea battle decides the country's destiny.
strings.allies battle 3 Montgomery 1:
Germany and Italy are moving again. Their commander 
General Rommel is very talented.
strings.allies battle 3 Montgomery 2:
He is like a fox in the desert. We have to watch out his 
armour forces.
strings.allies battle 3 Rommel 1: Assaulting in the desert is undesirable for my armour forces.
strings.allies battle 4 Zhukov 1:
The battle plan is revised again and again before the 
headquarters make a final call.
strings.allies battle 4 Zhukov 2:
This is such a massive war that we put almost all forces 
we have in it.
strings.allies battle 4 Rokossovsky 1:
This campaign is unprecedented yet crucial. You can't be 
too careful about it.
strings.allies battle 4 Guderian 1: My tank forces cut into the enemy's heartland like a knife.
strings.allies battle 4 Goering 1: My ace forces already freak the enemy out.
strings.allies battle 5 Patton 1:
Commander! We must overcome the Italians quickly, 
because the Germans are on the way.
strings.allies battle 5 Patton 2: We don't have too much time left.
strings.allies battle 5 Rommel 1:
According to the fuehrer, we will take over Italy's army and 
defense system.
strings.allies battle 6 Guider 1:
From intelligence we know Japan's elite troops are 
assembling in Burma. I believe they will march to India 
soon.
strings.allies battle 6 Zhang 1:
Commander! The Chinese forces will assist you from the 
side to beat Japan. We share the same goal.
strings.allies battle 6 Yamamoto 1:
We get serious supply problems. Disease also starts to 
spread.
strings.allies battle 6 Yamamoto 2: But for the Mikado we have nothing to fear.
strings.allies battle 7 Nimitz 1:
We made a lot of preparation earlier, but such a massive 
landing operation is totally new.
strings.allies battle 7 Patton 1:
This time German troops are led by Rommel for defense. I 
can't wait to challenge him.
strings.allies battle 7 de Gaulle 1: Finally we are home! To liberate France, move on!
strings.allies battle 7 Nimitz 2:
Our soldiers have some difficulty when landing. My fleet will 
spare no efforts to cover them.
strings.allies battle 7 Rommel 1:
If my defense line is breached, my armour forces will come 
to help immediately.
strings.allies battle 8 MacArthur 1:
Germany refuses to surrender. Their main forces are 
concentrated within the country.
strings.allies battle 8 MacArthur 2:
Soviet Union is moving forward Warsaw in east front. Poland 
will get free sooner or later.
strings.allies battle 8 Patton 1:
Commander! My tanks will charge forward. Follow me. 
Victory belongs to us.
strings.allies battle 8 Goering 1: Nothing can break the great Third Reich down.
strings.allies battle 8 Rommel 1:
Our soldiers are good, but there are way too many 
enemies!
strings.allies battle 9 Zhang 1:
Now two of the axis powers, Germany and Italy, have put 
up the white flag. The situation is in our favor.
strings.allies battle 9 Zhang 2:
The headquarters decide to launch a large campaign on 
Japan. We are going to make up the lost ground.
strings.allies battle 9 Zhang 3:
This morning Soviet Union just declared war against Japan 
who currently takes up the northeast China. So Japan has 
to deal with two battles.
strings.allies battle 10 MacArthur 1:
Japan is ready for a defensive war. They claim they will 
fight to the last man.
strings.allies battle 10 MacArthur 2:
I can imagine how crazy the Japanese would be. The 
samurai moral is no kidding!
strings.allies battle 10 MacArthur 3:
Commander! Don't feel any mercy for them. You can use 
our new weapon - atomic bomb if necessary.
strings.allies battle 10 Nimitz 1:
No one but us can compete with Japanese navy. Allies 
need us to protect their carriers.
strings.allies battle 10 Yamamoto 1: Soldiers! For Mikado, let's fight to the last minute!
strings.wto battle 1 Peng 1:
The reunification is almost coming true. But at this time 
American fleet shows up along the coast.
strings.wto battle 1 Peng 2:
Commander! America has far more advanced weapons than 
us. You need to adjust your strategy.
strings.wto battle 1 Peng 3:
I can't give you any help now, because the headquarters 
send my army to aid Korea.
strings.wto battle 1 MacArthur 1:
We should finish the war before Christmas. Then soldiers 
can spend the holiday with their families.
strings.wto battle 2 Guider 1:
Indian troops are deep into Tibetan areas. They are not 
alone. Britain is behind them.
strings.wto battle 2 Guider 2:
The headquarters have approved your battle plan. First divide 
and encircle the enemy, then wipe them out.
strings.wto battle 2 Guider 3: General Peng is coming to assist you as fast as possible.
strings.wto battle 2 Peng 1:
Obviously India underestimated us. They thought they could 
win with America's weapons.
strings.wto battle 3 Zhukov 1: Oil in Arab areas is the ultimate key to success.
strings.wto battle 3 Zhukov 2:
We must move quickly. Take up the area before American 
army arrives.
strings.wto battle 4 Rokossovsky 1: It's impossible to beat their fleet.
strings.wto battle 4 Rokossovsky 2:
What we can do is building more costal artillery and waiting 
for them.
strings.wto battle 4 Rokossovsky 3:
We must stop them landing. Otherwise, we will face terrible 
situation.
strings.wto battle 5 Guider 1: Commander! Bulgaria is at stake now!
strings.wto battle 5 Guider 2: The headquarters realize you must set off to save them.
strings.wto battle 6 Rokossovsky 1:
Commander! Our union faces the most severe test ever. 
The enemy is mounting an all-out attack.
strings.wto battle 6 Rokossovsky 2:
The headquarters want us to strike back from different 
directions.
strings.wto battle 7 Guider 1:
American intelligence already discovers our plan to invade 
South America.
strings.wto battle 7 Guider 2:
They begin to deploy troops in South America. Commander! 
Hurry up! Blow them out of water!
strings.wto battle 7 Guider 3:
We must take the missile launcher to designated location. 
This is of great importance to our success.
strings.nato battle 1 Patton 1:
Commander! The Soviet Union has built a nuclear site in 
Cuba.
strings.nato battle 1 Patton 2:
So far their nuclear bomb can destroy the whole North 
America. We can't keep silent anymore.
strings.nato battle 1 Patton 3:
Our goal is to kick them out of South America and remove 
nuclear threat.
strings.nato battle 1 Patton 4:
We have to speed up. They could trigger the nuclear bomb 
any minute.
strings.nato battle 2 Montgomery 1: The Red Army starts to expand its power in Europe.
strings.nato battle 2 Montgomery 2:
Commander! I hope you can use the fortification to hang on 
a few more days.
strings.nato battle 2 Montgomery 3:
My army would head to European mainland as fast as we 
can.
strings.nato battle 2 Zhukov 1:
The whole Europe will become red very soon. The First 
Secretary is looking forward to it.
strings.nato battle 3 de Gaulle 1:
I'm fighting against Poland. I'm worried Hungary nearby may 
attack me from behind.
strings.nato battle 3 de Gaulle 2:
Of course, the Soviet Union in back of them is the real 
enemy.
strings.nato battle 3 Patton 1:
Commander! The headquarters transfer me from Europe to 
help you out in Africa.
strings.nato battle 3 Patton 2:
It costs them a lot of work to convey my tanks from 
America.
strings.nato battle 3 Patton 3: I believe my tanks are extremely useful to you.
strings.nato battle 4 Nimitz 1:
At present those Arab oil fields are controlled by the 
Soviets. We want them back.
strings.nato battle 4 Nimitz 2:
Just as planned, their main forces are distracted when I 
approach Turkey.
strings.nato battle 4 Nimitz 3:
You must seize the moment to get through the channel. 
My fleet there will cover you.
strings.nato battle 5 MacArthur 1:
Obviously India has swung to the Soviet Union, which 
means we have a lot of difficulties to land Asia.
strings.nato battle 5 MacArthur 2:
Commander! It's a tough battle. My navy will assist you in 
Indian Ocean.
strings.nato battle 5 MacArthur 3:
How is everything going? I guess my position is worse than 
yours.
strings.nato battle 6 MacArthur 1:
Commander! My army is defending the Soviet Union and 
North Korea in the Sea of Japan.
strings.nato battle 6 MacArthur 2:
We look to you to take care of South Pacific. Australia 
should give you some help.
strings.nato battle 7 Guider 1: Commander! I have some bad news.
strings.nato battle 7 Guider 2:
The other commanders fail to reach target locations. It 
seems the enemy is more stubborn than the headquarters 
expected.
strings.nato battle 7 Guider 3:
Although it's highly difficult, you are the only choice to 
carry out final attack.
strings.nato battle 7 Guider 4:
You don't have to rush aggression. The headquarters leave 
you enough time to conduct operations.
strings.victory axis:
The axis nations cannot win without your excellent leadership. 
Commander! Wish you an epic military career!
strings.victory allies:
The war has exacted a heavy price from all of us, but finally we 
succeed. Commander! I’m sure your operational art will go down in 
history and encourage every person who loves peace.
strings.victory wto:
At last, under threat of nuclear weapons America is willing to talk 
with us peacefully. You and your men have rendered outstanding 
service. It’s you guys who change the whole world! Your name will 
remain forever in history!
strings.victory nato:
After the lost war, significant changes take place in the Soviet Union. 
The red flag slowly lowered from Kremlin marks the huge union 
finally collapses. From now on, the Soviet Union will be the history 
while peace has come into the world! Your hard working over years 
is rewarded with gains! Motherland will never forget you!
strings.locked warning:
After axis or allies campaign, 
you can move on to WTO and 
NATO battles.

strings.warning text 4: Some player left the game and you can't continue.

strings.newgame1_service_1:
Easytech devotes to design and develop the 
most brilliant strategy games on military 
affairs.
strings.newgame1_service_2:
If you have any suggestions or questions, 
please contact us by email: 
easytechservice@outlook.com
strings.newgame2_txt_1:
Dear commander, thank you very much 
for your support all the time.
strings.newgame2_txt_2:
To provide better experience, we sincerely 
invite you to help improve the game. You 
can offer your valuable comments and 
suggestions and create a more brilliant 
nmilitary career.
